### Boasting in the Right Things (Person): Praying through Jeremiah 9:23-24 (NIV)
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/boasting-in-the-right-things-person-praying-through-jeremiah-923-24-niv/
Passage: Jeremiah 9:23-24
Points:
- People naturally drift toward trusting human intelligence, physical strength, or material wealth for security.
- God graciously exposes these false confidences and draws believers back to gospel truth.
- A believer's sole legitimate boast is knowing God through His gracious personal revelation.
- The Lord delights in exercising steadfast kindness, justice, and righteousness, which are fully revealed in Christ.

### A Reason to Boast
Author: Katherine Britton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-june-3-2009-11604307.html
Passage: Jeremiah 9:23-24
Points:
- Modern self-help culture and cultural expectations subtly encourage believers to rely on self-sufficiency.
- Reading Scripture merely as a tool for personal improvement fuels spiritual pride.
- Contemplating the cross of Jesus strips away all human arrogance and grounds true humility.
- The Lord establishes that the only worthy boast is knowing Him and understanding His character.
- Lasting faith requires shifting our focus away from self-effort and onto God's mercy and glory.
